Subject: Internal: Trailhead spike — quick triage notes

Grace / Kim,

Looks like the initial signals are consistent with a short-lived batching misclassification on our streaming router: an experimental prefix-caching optimization we rolled to a small cohort on 2026-05-29 (can confirm rollout list). That optimization changed how we attribute tokens between continuous streaming sessions and batched inference. We didn't expect it to affect token counts at this magnitude — possible double-count of prefix tokens when sessions reopened.

My plan:
- Pull full request-level logs (we have a ready export job) for tenant=trailhead-prod and correlate by API key + request_id to Sophia's CSV.
- Run a quick diff of tokens_in/tokens_out between pre-rollout (2026-05-28) and 2026-05-31 to quantify delta.
- If we confirm double-count, recommend retroactive adjustment on the May invoice and a provisional credit while we reconcile.

Kim — can you draft a credit memo template we can apply if the delta exceeds 2%? Also tagging billing ops runbook.

Ben
